### Red team · Question

Event: `d0ae2a9e7031a9804ce4872e0832eed1` · 2026-09-24T15:12:49Z

> K5a review round 1 (defensive), d7b3cc21f against 06b2affe3. Merge verdict: BLOCK, on test coverage only. The kernel and model code is correct; the boot test does not yet cover plan v2's list.
> 
> Ran: ./test --arch rv64 map-fixed-attack PASS. REDOUBT_MODEL_MUTATIONS=R11MapFixedSkipsOverlap mutations_are_caught: caught by kernel_sequence seed 1 ('R6: frame 2 is charged to 7 but mapped nowhere'). model --test map_fixed_contracts: 8/8 pass.
> 
> Code confirmed:
> - kernel/src/mem.rs:1253-1302: the order is user_range, overlap, flags (three-way, W+X included), pages, pages+tables, matching the Errors row. Nothing is charged or allocated before the last check.
> - The .expects after the charge can't be reached: prepare_map's is_occupied is weaker than range_available_in's !is_empty; flags are checked; tables were counted; alloc_page's physical-RAM assumption is named, as in process_map.
> - range_available_in / subtree_occupied (arch/riscv/mem.rs:651-697): the jump is clamped to end. wrapping_add can reach 0 only at the top of the address space, and end <= USER_AREA_END (2^38 on rv64, 2^31 on rv32) keeps it unreachable. A non-table entry above the leaf level fails closed (child() is is_table()). Level spans come from leaf_size and vpn, so 1024 entries on Sv32 and 512 on Sv39 are right.
> - The model's order (model/src/kernel.rs map_fixed) gives the same result as the kernel at every step.
> - The saturating_sub in alloc_va's fallback hides nothing. p.space.range is ascending and cursor = max(cursor, v+1), so v >= cursor and hi >= cursor always hold, and saturating_sub is ordinary subtraction that avoids the overflow in cursor+n. A hostile huge n gives OutOfMemory in both: the model finds no gap, and the kernel's find_virtual_address checked_sub fails, which map_run turns into OutOfMemory.
> - R11MapFixedSkipsOverlap bites: it is caught through the leaked frame (R6), not by a 'never replaces' property. That is acceptable.
> 
> Findings:
> P2-1 tests/programs/src/bin/map-fixed-attack.rs:92-105: nothing tests the 'page tables' half of the charge check, in the kernel or the model. free+1 pages is refused by the pages check alone. That second check is the only thing that keeps an under-count in tables_needed from reaching the .expect at mem.rs:1285/1293 and panicking the kernel. Plan v2 item: fill with map_anon until free == npages+tables-1, then map_fixed a 2-page range that crosses a 2 MiB boundary in an unused GiB (e.g. 0x1_0000_0000-0x1000 on rv64, which needs an L1 table plus 2 L0 tables, so 5 pages). Expect OutOfMemory with usage unchanged. Free one more page and expect success with usage exactly +5.
> P2-2 :71-76: the untouched legacy reservation isn't tested. The stack is reserved as [sp-128K, sp) (services.rs:482, arch/riscv/process.rs:396), so USER_STACK_TOP - 128*1024 is an untouched reservation. Add refused(c, "untouched stack reservation", USER_STACK_TOP - DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE, PAGE, ...). Today, changing subtree_occupied's !is_empty() to is_occupied passes every test.
> P2-3 :107-120: 'huge len promptly' has no teeth. 1 GiB is 2^18 pages, so a regression to one walk per page takes milliseconds and never trips the 30 s timeout. Use addr 0x1_0000_0000, len USER_AREA_END - 0x1_0000_0000 (about 2^26 pages, free on rv64, since the stack sits below 0x8000_0000), and assert that the time_now delta is under a bound such as 10 ms.
> P2-4: the lent-in and lent-out cases from plan v2 are missing. The kernel refuses them only because S-bit PTEs are non-empty, and the model's check is a different mechanism (LentIn/LentOut in p.space). Add them, or get an explicit orchestrator waiver.
> P3-5 :61: 'straddles USER_AREA_END' uses USER_AREA_END - PAGE/2, which is unaligned, so the alignment check refuses it first. The model test at map_fixed_contracts.rs:85 does the same. A real straddle is addr USER_AREA_END - PAGE with len 2*PAGE.
> P3-6 :143-155: the last page is unmapped before the map_anon check, so the kernel half of P1-1 (map_anon while a page just below USER_AREA_END is mapped) isn't exercised. Keep it mapped across the map_anon call.
> P3-7: 'flags enforced' tests only that an RW page is writable. A write to an R-only page faulting (via attack-checker) is still missing.
> P3-8 libs/sys/src/tests.rs, user_range_at_width: this tests a copy of the check, not the kernel's user_range (a cfg(baremetal) function), so a change to the kernel wouldn't fail it. It's fine as documentation; say so, or share the function.

> EXTRA, found while deriving item 3 (please review): kernel/src/arch/riscv/mem.rs:128 tables_needed deduplicated missing tables by their index in the parent table. Below the root on Sv39 that index recurs in the next parent. Example: missing L0 at index 5 in GiB 3, present tables up to GiB 4 index 4, missing again at index 5 in GiB 4: it counted 1 where 2 are needed. That under-count takes a range of 1 GiB or more, and the budget to pay for it, and then hits the post-charge .expect (a kernel panic); process_map shares the helper. Fixed by naming a table `addr / leaf_size(level)`. The model (table_keys) was already right. No boot test covers it, because it needs a budget of 1 GiB or more.
